decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanEXISTING SITE PLAN 2605/05PROPOSED SITE PLAN 2605-06EXISITNG AND PROPOSED FLOOR PLANS 2605-01EXISTING AND PROPOSES SECTION A-A AND EXISTING FRONT ELEVATION 2605-02EXISTING ELEVATIONS AND SECTION A-A 2605-03PROPOSED ELEVATIONS AND SECTION A-A 2605-04Site PhotographsReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be in materials to match the existing building or carried out in materials as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Notwithstanding the approved plans, no further side panels, walls, screens, glazing, cladding or other means of enclosure shall be installed to the canopy hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To protect the residential amenities of the adjoining occupiers.
description: Erection of a rear canopy and patio (RETROSPECTIVE)
